segments.name: Oil and gas exploration and production
products: gathering, transportation, compression and dehydration services
segments.description: Independent energy company that explores for, develops and produces oil, natural gas and NGLs from U.S. assets for commodity purchasers.
segments.evidence: For financial reporting purposes, Devon aggregates its U.S. operating segments into one reporting segment due to the similar nature of these operations.

revenueModel.text: Purchasers pay for oil, gas and NGL production volumes delivered, and third-party producers pay for gathering and processing services.
revenueModel.evidence: Oil, gas and NGL sales are recognized when production is sold to a purchaser at a fixed or determinable price, delivery has occurred, control has transferred and collectability of the revenue is probable.
